<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude ko-KR terminology -->
In ko-KR UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Remote Control. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP 서버. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → 데스크톱 앱. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Session → 세션. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → 채팅. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → 사이드 채팅
- Skill → Skills. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → 아티팩트. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → 확장 프로그램. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → 컴퓨터 사용. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → 빠른 입력. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → 개발자
- Model → 모델. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Turn → 턴. zh-Hans uses 轮: 轮到您了, 上一轮失败, 轮次失败.
- Folder → 폴더. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → 워크스페이스
- Repository → 저장소
- Worktree → 워크트리. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → Git origin. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Sign in / Log in → 로그인. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → 조직 / 관리자
- Credentials → 자격 증명
- Plan → 플랜. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → 사용량（usage limits → 사용량 제한）
- Pin / Pinned → 고정. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → 신뢰. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → 허용
- Approve / Approved → 승인
- this computer → 컴퓨터. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → 휴대폰
- Cloud → 클라우드. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → 설정
- Configuration / Config → 구성. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → 창
- Terminal → 터미널
- Connect / Connected / Connection → 연결
- Restart → 다시 시작. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → 업데이트. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → 디버그 / 로그. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → 받아쓰기
